items.note: The prompt asks whether the July Pro price increase from 49 to 69 USD drove Pro churn, and says this is not a general churn analysis.
The prompt says to exclude every row where is_trial is yes.
The prompt says to exclude every row whose email ends in @ourco.test, calling them internal test accounts.
The prompt defines churn as an account having a cancel_month.
The prompt names the CEO as the audience.
The prompt asks for a plain-language summary of at most 5 bullets.
The prompt asks for one suggested chart and says what to specify: chart type, x-axis, y-axis and series.
The prompt asks for a short statement of how confident the conclusion is, given the small number of accounts.
